messages:
emily_marketing: Quick sync — launching an experiment to test: 1) reorder FAQ accordions, 2) two tier-name variants (Growth vs Scale), 3) a micro-calculator variant that surfaces monthly vs metered costs by region. We'll run for 2 weeks, split: EU traffic gets calculator variant B. Goal: cut trial dropoff by ~8% and lift demo signups +12%. Need launch post copy, webinar CTA, and inbound lead routing. Ping if you can't make the planning thread.

jules: Sounds good. For tier names can we avoid 'Performance' — that confuses with model perf. Suggest 'Scale' instead.

sam_sales: +1 to 'Scale'. Also propose adding a "Book demo" CTA in the calculator results when estimate >100k tokens/mo. That'll help routing.

mona_prod: On the FAQ reorder — recommend put billing and security questions first for mid-market buyers. Technical FAQ can be collapsed behind a "Developer notes" anchor.

alex_growth: For launch posts: 1 short hero announcement, 1 benchmark narrative (data-backed), and 1 webinar invite. I can draft the hero + webinar blurb if someone supplies benchmark takeaways.

emily_marketing: Alex that works. Jules/mona can you quick-approve naming and FAQ order by EOD? Sam — can you map the demo CTA to Sales routing in Intercom?

sam_sales: On it. Will add tag `pricing-calc-high-intent` and route to AE queue. Also will set a rule to escalate if tagged + account >50 seats.

jules: Leaning 'Scale' over 'Growth' — approved from my side.

mona_prod: FAQ order approved — I'll update the CMS blocks and add anchors for the technical section.

deploy-bot: Reminder: experiment flag 'pricing_v3_faq_calc' will be toggled in prod at 2026-04-05T09:00Z by @emily_marketing.

emily_marketing: Great — I'll schedule the hero post for launch day and draft webinar landing + signup flow. Sam, can you join a 15m brief tomorrow at 10:30 to confirm routing?

sam_sales: Yep, added to calendar and will bring the Intercom playbook notes.

alex_growth: I'll post draft hero + webinar blurb by noon, and a lightweight benchmark narrative for review (key metrics + methodology).

emily_marketing: Perfect — thanks all. We'll iterate on copy before flipping the flag. :rocket:
